context.transcript:
Thank you all for volunteering to work this extra shift on a Saturday to help relocate our offices.
I really appreciate that you all volunteered for the work.
First, we're going to load the boxes and crates into the trucks outside.
Be sure to use the carts that are in the lobby to move everything outside.
If you have any questions, please ask me at any time.
At about noon, we'll break for lunch.
Lunch is on the company today, so please let Mary know what you'd like to eat.
context.transcript_translation:
感谢大家自愿在周六工作额外的班次来帮助搬迁我们的办公室。
我非常感谢你们所有人都愿意为这项工作而志愿服务。
首先，我们要把箱子和木箱装到外面的卡车里。
请务必使用大堂里的推车将所有东西移到外面。
如果您有任何问题，请随时问我。
大约中午，我们将休息吃午饭。
今天的午餐由公司提供，所以请让 Mary 知道您想吃什么。
